name: Feasibility: Affiliate program
description:
Owner per PRD: Commercial team (Daniel Hrouzek).

As-Is: manual tracking in Salesforce, manual UTM link distribution, duplicate check with Sales (manual + Keboola), Power BI reports sent as monthly screenshots. No Core affiliate program exists for the CZ market — the portal is a direct prerequisite for launching it.

h2. Scope in PRD

- Application to the affiliate program — a partner can be a Premium affiliate without being in the Partner Program, so two separate dashboard views are needed
- Approve / reject application
- Automatic generation of affiliate code and UTM link
- Affiliate dashboard: payout eligibility, progress graph, project overview, commissions
- Reward calculation and invoicing
- Program and commission structure description
- E-shop overview (status, subscription plan, link to admin)

h2. To analyse

- Duplicate-check logic (affiliate × Sales) — how to move it from manual + Keboola into the portal (OQ-09)
- Replacing monthly Power BI screenshots with a live dashboard — who owns the data source (OQ-10)
- Attribution: where affiliate code → e-shop → subscription is recorded and how reliable it is
- Commission calculation — reuse existing logic or reimplement
- Two-view dashboard model (Partner Program member vs. standalone affiliate)

h2. Output

Systems involved, integration gaps, T-shirt size, blockers, MVP / later / out-of-scope recommendation.
